voice.summary: Noor Linden writes in first person with a quiet confidence: short, specific and light on adjectives. Each project is described by what it solved and for whom, with the year and role stated.
dos: Write in first person, present tense
Name the problem, the user and the result
State year and role beside every project
donts: Do not claim to be 'passionate' or 'a ninja'
Never list tools instead of outcomes

taglines: From first sketch to shipped system
Design that stays out of the way
boilerplate: Noor Linden is an independent product designer who shapes calm interfaces for everyday tools, from the first sketch to the shipped design system.
